snippet.title: Dovetail Direct 2026 - Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of Sodor
snippet.description:
Meet some of the team behind the development of Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of Sodor from our latest Dovetail Direct.

Discover our first roadmap reveal, get a glimpse at two upcoming characters and check out Thomas’ new LBSC livery, now available to all players.

There’s plenty more to come on Sodor! Stay tuned to our social channels to find out more as soon as it's ready.

Read more in our article: https://bit.ly/46zQ1Jk

Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of  Sodor is out  now on Steam, Epic Games, PlayStation, Xbox and Nintendo Switch via https://bit.ly/Wonders-Of-Sodor-Launch-4
